title: stegania procera
intro: Stegania procera, commonly known as the "eye balm plant," is a plant species in the family Scrophulariaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Africa, to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, such as soothing eye infections, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Stegania procera include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating eye and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Stegania procera include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
